name: Private relay
blurb: A rack in a harbour data hall, leased under a name that is not yours. It goes into your address book as a relay that slows a trace more than any open one, and it never warms up however often you use it.

name: Safe house
blurb: A second address with a line of its own. A trace that gets home finds this one: you lie low half as long, the heat on you fades twice as fast, and no trace burns a part out of your gateway again.

name: Second gateway
blurb: A second rig racked beside the first and wired to share the load: one more connection at a time, two more programs running at once, and 16 GB more memory to load.
